name: Glulxe
author: Andrew Plotkin (Glulxe, CheapGlk)
description: Plays modern interactive fiction (Inform 7 / Glulx, .ulx and .gblorb) in the Terminal. Copy a story to /sdcard/home and type glulxe story.gblorb. Free games: ifdb.org, ifarchive.org.
